description: Dual finish nomenclature. Both systems are in active use and both must be interpreted (NR-3).
warning: US19 and US26D are DIFFERENT satins. Never treat them as interchangeable when matching.

finishes.note: Seen on Ives 700 hinges and 8400 kick plates in the Dutch Bros fixture.

hager_rules: Split finish is priced at the higher finish.
Levers prepped for SFIC cores are available only in US10B, US26D and BLK.
Anti-microbial is available on 26D only (list adder 57.13).
premium_finish_rule: Premium and lead-time finishes are priced as an ADDER on top of the base price - see reference-library/adders/manual_adders.json
